Run the chunks from top to bottom, or use **Knit** in RStudio. Change the
parameters below, then rerun from the simulation chunk onward. Plot objects
and data tables stay in the R session when you run chunks interactively.
All simulation and plotting code is in this file; it does not source the
panel scripts or read their saved data. It uses this repository's renv.

From the repository root, render an HTML copy into the ignored `out/` folder:

```{r render-example, eval=FALSE}
dir.create("out/fig1_playground", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
rmarkdown::render("figure/fig1/fig1_playground.Rmd",
                  output_dir = "out/fig1_playground")
```

The plots use ggplot2 and patchwork. They show the same quantities as the
panel generators with simpler layouts. Running this notebook does not
refresh the existing panel CSVs, RDS, SVGs or previews.

**Caption convention for every plot below:** illustrative simulated data
for figure development; no benchmark or general ranking is claimed.

## Parameters

Keep three components: the simplex plots show the two nontrivial dimensions
of a three-component model. Use at least two markers per component and two
background genes for the default heatmap selection. Seeds in `draw_seeds`
vary both signal and noise. Within a seed, all noise models share the signal;
both scalings share the observed matrix. Keep `representative_draw` in
`draw_seeds`. Keep the definitions and order of `scalings` and `models`
unchanged: these lists define the fixed comparisons used throughout. Defaults match the current
Figure 1 generators.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(GeneralDualSimplex)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5, dpi = 120,
                      message = FALSE, warning = TRUE, cache = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))
```

```{r parameters}
mixture_parameters <- list(
  n_feature = 500L,
  n_sample = 200L,
  n_component = 3L,
  n_marker = 20L,
  marker_fold = 5,
  profile_spread_sd = 0.2
)
library_fraction <- 0.04
# A's signal also determines automatic phi and sigma for panels C–F.
panel_A_seed <- 1L
draw_seeds <- 1:5
representative_draw <- 1L
# Fixed comparison definitions; retain their entries and order.
scalings <- c("uniform", "expression")
models <- c("Poisson", "Proportional", "Normal, floored at 0")

# NULL matches relative noise at panel A's median expected count, before flooring.
proportional_phi <- NULL
normal_sigma <- NULL

# Heatmap controls; only these displays select genes and samples.
heatmap_genes <- c(paste0("marker", rep(1:3, each = 2), ".", 1:2),
                   "background1", "background2")
heatmap_min_fraction <- 0.1
heatmap_targets <- rbind(
  c(.65, .20, .15), c(.55, .30, .15), c(.40, .40, .20),
  c(.20, .60, .20), c(.15, .55, .30), c(.20, .35, .45),
  c(.20, .20, .60), c(.33, .33, .34)
)

# Display controls: changing these does not require recomputing data.
scaling_colours <- c(uniform = "#E07B28", expression = "#2A7BBF")
gene_colours <- c(background = "#B8B8B8", marker1 = "#009E73",
                  marker2 = "#CC79A7", marker3 = "#D69B00", samples = "#929292")
point_size <- 0.8
point_alpha <- 0.8
band_alpha <- 0.18
```

Additional `GenerateMixture` arguments can go in `mixture_parameters` (for
example `alpha`, `cell_size`, `marker_range`, `background_range`, or
`marker_spread_sd`). Unlisted arguments retain the installed package defaults.
Smaller `library_fraction` means shallower sampling. Changing a distribution
parameter regenerates the signal and changes all dependent panels.

## Shared simulation and projection code

The baseline expected count matrix is `mu = library_fraction * W %*% H`.
Poisson noise uses `ApplyNBNoise` with dispersion zero. Proportional noise is
`mu * Gamma(shape = 1/phi, rate = 1/phi)`, with variance `phi * mu^2`.
Normal noise is `pmax(mu + N(0, sigma^2), 0)`. Flooring raises its mean above
`mu` and lowers its variance below `sigma^2`. With automatic noise settings,
`phi = 1/median(mu_A)` and `sigma = sqrt(median(mu_A))`; the relative noise
matches at that one count **before flooring**.

```{r simulation}
generate_signal <- function(seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  do.call(GenerateMixture, mixture_parameters)
}

A <- generate_signal(panel_A_seed)
A$signal <- A$W %*% A$H
A$observed <- ApplyNBNoise(A, dispersion = 0,
                           library_size_fraction = library_fraction)$Observed
median_expected_count_A <- median(library_fraction * A$signal)
phi <- if (is.null(proportional_phi)) 1 / median_expected_count_A else proportional_phi
sigma <- if (is.null(normal_sigma)) sqrt(median_expected_count_A) else normal_sigma
noise_parameters <- data.frame(
  model = models, library_fraction, median_expected_count_A,
  phi = c(NA, phi, NA), sigma = c(NA, NA, sigma),
  replicates = length(draw_seeds), representative_draw
)
print(noise_parameters, row.names = FALSE)

simulate_draw <- function(seed, model) {
  sim <- generate_signal(seed)
  sim$signal <- sim$W %*% sim$H
  sim$mu <- library_fraction * sim$signal
  sim$observed <- switch(model,
    Poisson = ApplyNBNoise(sim, dispersion = 0,
                          library_size_fraction = library_fraction)$Observed,
    Proportional = sim$mu * matrix(rgamma(length(sim$mu), shape = 1 / phi,
                                         rate = 1 / phi), nrow(sim$mu)),
    `Normal, floored at 0` = pmax(sim$mu + matrix(rnorm(length(sim$mu), 0, sigma),
                                                nrow(sim$mu)), 0)
  )
  sim
}

fit_view <- function(sim, scaling) {
  keep <- rowSums(sim$observed) > 0
  V <- sim$observed[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  object <- CreateDSO(V) |> ScaleDSO(type = scaling) |>
    FindProjection(k = mixture_parameters$n_component, method = "svd")
  s <- object@scaling
  g <- object@projection$gsvd()
  W <- sim$W[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  basis_H <- t(g$Psi) * (g$b / s$c)
  basis_W <- t(g$Phi) * (g$a / s$r)
  Q <- qr.Q(qr(basis_H))
  Qw <- qr.Q(qr(basis_W))
  Hor <- t(Q %*% crossprod(Q, t(sim$H)))
  Wor <- Qw %*% crossprod(Qw, W)
  list(V = V, mu = (library_fraction * sim$signal)[keep, , drop = FALSE],
       W = W, H = sim$H, s = s, g = g, oracle_H = Hor, oracle_W = Wor,
       metrics = data.frame(
         oracle_H_rmse = sqrt(mean((Hor - sim$H)^2)),
         oracle_W_rmse = sqrt(mean((Wor - W)^2)), genes = nrow(V),
         uniform_converged = if (scaling == "uniform") isTRUE(s$sinkhorn$converged) else NA,
         residual_orthogonality_error = max(abs((sim$H - Hor) %*% Q)),
         least_squares_agreement_error = max(abs(Hor - t(basis_H %*% qr.coef(qr(basis_H), t(sim$H))))),
         W_residual_orthogonality_error = max(abs(crossprod(Qw, W - Wor))),
         W_least_squares_agreement_error = max(abs(Wor - basis_W %*% qr.coef(qr(basis_W), W)))))
}

# Only a rigid rotation/reflection and translation: no axis stretching.
orient_simplex <- function(coordinates, vertices) {
  target <- rbind(c(0, 2 / sqrt(6)), c(1 / sqrt(2), -1 / sqrt(6)),
                  c(-1 / sqrt(2), -1 / sqrt(6)))
  centre <- colMeans(vertices[, 2:3])
  v <- sweep(vertices[, 2:3], 2, centre, "-")
  rotation <- svd(crossprod(v, target))
  rotation <- rotation$u %*% t(rotation$v)
  list(points = sweep(coordinates[, 2:3], 2, centre, "-") %*% rotation,
       vertices = v %*% rotation)
}

gene_geometry <- function(fit) {
  s <- fit$s; g <- fit$g
  F <- sweep(fit$V, 2, s$c, "*"); F <- F / rowSums(F)
  T <- sweep(fit$H, 2, s$c, "*"); T <- T / rowSums(T)
  C <- F %*% t(g$Psi)
  xy <- orient_simplex(C, T %*% t(g$Psi))
  group <- ifelse(grepl("^marker", rownames(fit$V)),
                   sub("^marker([0-9]+)\\..*$", "marker\\1", rownames(fit$V)), "background")
  F0 <- sweep(fit$mu, 2, s$c, "*"); F0 <- F0 / rowSums(F0)
  B0 <- sweep(fit$W, 2, rowSums(sweep(fit$H, 2, s$c, "*")), "*")
  B0 <- B0 / rowSums(B0)
  list(points = data.frame(gene = rownames(fit$V), group, x = xy$points[, 1], y = xy$points[, 2]),
       vertices = data.frame(component = 1:3, x = xy$vertices[, 1], y = xy$vertices[, 2]),
       checks = data.frame(
         coordinate_identity_error = max(abs(C - t(g$Phi) %*% diag(g$sigma[1:3]))),
         constant_coordinate_error = max(abs(C[, 1] - 1)),
         noiseless_convex_error = max(abs(F0 - B0 %*% T))))
}

sample_geometry <- function(fit) {
  s <- fit$s; g <- fit$g
  F <- fit$V * s$r; F <- sweep(F, 2, colSums(F), "/")
  T <- fit$W * s$r; T <- sweep(T, 2, colSums(T), "/")
  C <- t(g$Phi %*% F)
  xy <- orient_simplex(C, t(g$Phi %*% T))
  F0 <- fit$mu * s$r; F0 <- sweep(F0, 2, colSums(F0), "/")
  B0 <- fit$H * colSums(fit$W * s$r); B0 <- sweep(B0, 2, colSums(B0), "/")
  list(points = data.frame(sample = colnames(fit$V), group = "samples",
                          x = xy$points[, 1], y = xy$points[, 2]),
       vertices = data.frame(component = 1:3, x = xy$vertices[, 1], y = xy$vertices[, 2]),
       checks = data.frame(
         constant_coordinate_error = max(abs(C[, 1] - 1)),
         svd_coordinate_identity_error = max(abs(t(C) - g$sigma * g$Psi)),
         noiseless_convex_error = max(abs(F0 - T %*% B0))))
}

project_nontrivial <- function(X, u, v) {
  X <- X - u %o% as.vector(crossprod(u, X))
  X - as.vector(X %*% v) %o% v
}
```

The gene simplex maps normalized observed rows and known normalized H rows
with the same `Psi`. The sample simplex maps normalized observed columns
and known normalized W columns with the same `Phi`. Dashed triangles join
known projected components; no vertices are fitted. All nonzero observed
genes and all samples are retained in their respective point clouds.

Oracle errors are unconstrained Euclidean least-squares projections. The H
row space is spanned by the rows of `Psi D_b D_c^-1`; the W column space is
`span(D_r^-1 D_a Phi^T)`. Orthonormalizing these bases gives
`H_oracle = H Q Q^T` and `W_oracle = Qw Qw^T W`. There is no clipping or
factor normalization. W errors use the original simulated expression units,
before the library fraction; H errors use fraction units. These errors do
not measure distances from plotted points to a triangle.

## Shared plotting code

Each simplex plot has its own limits and equal aspect. Coordinates are
rigidly oriented mixtures of GSVD dimensions 2 and 3.

```{r plotting-helpers}
simplex_panel <- function(points, vertices, title, error, sample_side) {
  triangle <- rbind(vertices, vertices[1, ])
  vertices$group <- paste0("marker", vertices$component)
  plot <- ggplot(points, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = point_size, alpha = point_alpha) +
    geom_path(data = triangle, colour = "grey40", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = gene_colours, labels = function(groups) {
      if (sample_side) sub("^marker", "component", groups) else groups
    }) + coord_equal() +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = sprintf("oracle RMSE: %.3f", error),
         x = "Projection 2", y = "Projection 3", colour = NULL)
  if (sample_side) plot <- plot + geom_point(data = vertices, aes(colour = group), size = 2)
  plot
}

plot_simplices <- function(points, vertices, metrics, side, ncol) {
  plots <- list()
  for (sc in scalings) for (noise_model in unique(as.character(points$model))) {
    p <- subset(points, scaling == sc & model == noise_model)
    v <- subset(vertices, scaling == sc & model == noise_model)
    m <- subset(metrics, scaling == sc & model == noise_model)
    plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- simplex_panel(
      p, v, paste(noise_model, sc, sep = "\n"), m[[paste0("oracle_", side, "_rmse")]],
      sample_side = side == "H")
  }
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol, guides = "collect")
}
```

## A: one simulated mixture, heatmaps and gene simplices

W is scaled within each displayed row. H shows its actual fractions.
Signal and observation share a per-gene display maximum, after adjusting
the observation by the known library fraction for display only. The
selected mixed samples affect the heatmaps only.

```{r panel-a-data}
A_fits <- lapply(scalings, function(sc) fit_view(A, sc))
names(A_fits) <- scalings
A_gene_points <- A_vertices <- A_metrics <- A_checks <- list()
for (sc in scalings) {
  geometry <- gene_geometry(A_fits[[sc]])
  A_gene_points[[sc]] <- cbind(model = "Poisson", scaling = sc, geometry$points)
  A_vertices[[sc]] <- cbind(model = "Poisson", scaling = sc, geometry$vertices)
  A_metrics[[sc]] <- cbind(model = "Poisson", scaling = sc, A_fits[[sc]]$metrics)
  A_checks[[sc]] <- cbind(scaling = sc, geometry$checks)
}
A_gene_points <- do.call(rbind, A_gene_points)
A_vertices <- do.call(rbind, A_vertices)
A_metrics <- do.call(rbind, A_metrics)
A_checks <- do.call(rbind, A_checks)

available <- which(apply(A$H, 2, min) >= heatmap_min_fraction)
heatmap_sample_indices <- integer(nrow(heatmap_targets))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(heatmap_targets))) {
  distance <- colSums((A$H[, available, drop = FALSE] - heatmap_targets[i, ])^2)
  heatmap_sample_indices[i] <- available[which.min(distance)]
  available <- setdiff(available, heatmap_sample_indices[i])
}
Wshow <- A$W[heatmap_genes, , drop = FALSE]
Hshow <- A$H[, heatmap_sample_indices, drop = FALSE]
Xshow <- A$signal[heatmap_genes, heatmap_sample_indices, drop = FALSE]
Yshow <- A$observed[heatmap_genes, heatmap_sample_indices, drop = FALSE]
shared_max <- apply(cbind(Xshow, Yshow / library_fraction), 1, max)
tile <- function(name, raw, display) data.frame(
  matrix = name, row = c(row(raw)), col = c(col(raw)),
  value = c(display), raw_value = c(raw))
A_tiles <- rbind(tile("W", Wshow, Wshow / apply(Wshow, 1, max)),
                 tile("H", Hshow, Hshow),
                 tile("X", Xshow, Xshow / shared_max),
                 tile("Y", Yshow, (Yshow / library_fraction) / shared_max))
heatmap_samples <- data.frame(display_column = seq_along(heatmap_sample_indices),
  sample = colnames(A$H)[heatmap_sample_indices], t(Hshow))
print(heatmap_samples, row.names = FALSE)
print(A_metrics, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r panel-a-plots, fig.height=6}
heatmap_plots <- lapply(c("W", "H", "X", "Y"), function(name) {
  ggplot(subset(A_tiles, matrix == name), aes(col, row, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_reverse() + coord_equal() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey15", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = switch(name, W = "W", H = "H", X = "Signal W H", Y = "Observed V"),
         x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Display value")
})
plot_A_heatmaps <- wrap_plots(heatmap_plots, ncol = 4, guides = "collect")
plot_A_heatmaps
plot_A_genes <- plot_simplices(A_gene_points, A_vertices, A_metrics, "W", ncol = 2)
plot_A_genes
```

## B: gene and sample mass

Masses are the achieved marginals `a` and `b` of the scaled matrix, including
the fitted uniform scaling's numerical tolerance. Rank items by their
observed totals, breaking ties by name. The second plot preserves the
archived cumulative view without duplicating its data generator.

```{r panel-b-data}
mass_table <- function(totals, uniform_mass, expression_mass) {
  ord <- order(totals, names(totals))
  data.frame(rank = seq_along(totals), percent = 100 * seq_along(totals) / length(totals),
    item = names(totals)[ord], observed_total = totals[ord],
    uniform_share_percent = 100 * uniform_mass[ord],
    expression_share_percent = 100 * expression_mass[ord],
    uniform_cumulative_percent = 100 * cumsum(uniform_mass[ord]),
    expression_cumulative_percent = 100 * cumsum(expression_mass[ord]),
    raw_cumulative_percent = 100 * cumsum(totals[ord] / sum(totals)))
}
mass_by_gene <- mass_table(rowSums(A_fits$uniform$V), A_fits$uniform$s$a,
                           A_fits$expression$s$a)
mass_by_sample <- mass_table(colSums(A_fits$uniform$V), A_fits$uniform$s$b,
                             A_fits$expression$s$b)
mass_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Genes", "Samples"), function(margin) {
  d <- if (margin == "Genes") mass_by_gene else mass_by_sample
  do.call(rbind, lapply(scalings, function(sc) data.frame(
    margin, scaling = sc, rank = d$rank, percent = d$percent,
    observed_total = d$observed_total, raw_cumulative_percent = d$raw_cumulative_percent,
    share = d[[paste0(sc, "_share_percent")]],
    cumulative = d[[paste0(sc, "_cumulative_percent")]])))
}))
at_observed_half <- function(data, y) {
  approx(c(0, data$raw_cumulative_percent), c(0, y), xout = 50, ties = "ordered")$y
}
margin_summary <- function(data, prefix, target) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  data.frame(
    quantity = paste0(prefix, c("_count", "_uniform_mass_max_abs_deviation_from_target",
      "_uniform_cumulative_percent_at_observed_half",
      "_expression_cumulative_percent_at_observed_half",
      "_items_percent_at_observed_half", "_max_abs_raw_minus_expression_cumulative_percent",
      "_observed_total_min", "_observed_total_max", "_expression_share_percent_min",
      "_expression_share_percent_max", "_expression_share_max_over_min",
      "_uniform_share_percent_min", "_uniform_share_percent_max",
      "_items_percent_expression_above_uniform")),
    value = c(n, max(abs(data$uniform_share_percent / 100 - target)),
      at_observed_half(data, data$uniform_cumulative_percent),
      at_observed_half(data, data$expression_cumulative_percent),
      100 * sum(data$raw_cumulative_percent < 50) / n,
      max(abs(data$raw_cumulative_percent - data$expression_cumulative_percent)),
      min(data$observed_total), max(data$observed_total),
      min(data$expression_share_percent), max(data$expression_share_percent),
      max(data$expression_share_percent) / min(data$expression_share_percent),
      min(data$uniform_share_percent), max(data$uniform_share_percent),
      100 * mean(data$expression_share_percent > data$uniform_share_percent)))
}
mass_summary <- rbind(
  data.frame(quantity = c("genes_removed_by_filter", "uniform_converged", "uniform_iterations",
      "uniform_max_relative_marginal_error", "expression_total_mass", "uniform_total_mass"),
    value = c(nrow(A$observed) - nrow(A_fits$uniform$V), A_fits$uniform$s$sinkhorn$converged,
      A_fits$uniform$s$sinkhorn$iterations, A_fits$uniform$s$sinkhorn$max_relative_marginal_error,
      sum(A_fits$expression$s$a), sum(A_fits$uniform$s$a))),
  margin_summary(mass_by_gene, "genes", 1 / nrow(A_fits$uniform$V)),
  margin_summary(mass_by_sample, "samples", 1 / ncol(A_fits$uniform$V)))
print(mass_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r panel-b-plots}
plot_B <- ggplot(mass_long, aes(rank, share, colour = scaling)) +
  geom_point(size = point_size) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scaling_colours) + facet_wrap(~margin, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Rank by observed total (low to high)", y = "Share of scaled total (%)")
plot_B
cumulative_origin <- mass_long[!duplicated(mass_long[c("margin", "scaling")]), ]
cumulative_origin$percent <- cumulative_origin$raw_cumulative_percent <- cumulative_origin$cumulative <- 0
plot_B_cumulative <- ggplot(rbind(cumulative_origin, mass_long),
  aes(raw_cumulative_percent, cumulative, colour = scaling)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey75") + geom_line() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scaling_colours) + facet_wrap(~margin) +
  labs(x = "Cumulative observed total (%)", y = "Cumulative scaled mass (%)")
plot_B_cumulative
```

## C–F and sample companion: shared repeated draws

One loop supplies all remaining panels. The weights are refitted to each
observed matrix. The representative draw is selected by seed in advance,
rather than by the appearance of its simplex. The tables include each
oracle factor entry, per-gene quantities, projection checks, and noiseless
oracle controls for later inspection.

```{r repeated-draws}
projection_metrics <- oracle_W <- oracle_H <- noiseless_metrics <- list()
C_gene_data <- signal_noise_split <- list()
D_genes <- D_vertices <- S_samples <- S_vertices <- projection_checks <- list()
for (noise_model in models) for (seed in draw_seeds) {
  sim <- simulate_draw(seed, noise_model)
  for (sc in scalings) {
    fit <- fit_view(sim, sc)
    key <- data.frame(model = noise_model, draw = seed, scaling = sc)
    projection_metrics[[length(projection_metrics) + 1]] <- cbind(key, fit$metrics)
    oracle_W[[length(oracle_W) + 1]] <- cbind(key, data.frame(
      component = rep(1:3, each = nrow(fit$W)), gene = rep(rownames(fit$W), 3),
      true_W = c(fit$W), oracle_W = c(fit$oracle_W)))
    oracle_H[[length(oracle_H) + 1]] <- cbind(key, data.frame(
      component = rep(1:3, ncol(fit$H)), sample = rep(colnames(fit$H), each = 3),
      true_H = c(fit$H), oracle_H = c(fit$oracle_H)))

    s <- fit$s
    Vtilde <- s$r * sweep(fit$V, 2, s$c, "*")
    Z <- s$r / sqrt(s$a) * sweep(fit$V, 2, s$c / sqrt(s$b), "*")
    u <- sqrt(s$a); v <- sqrt(s$b)
    E <- Z - u %o% v
    inertia <- rowSums(E^2)
    variance <- rowSums((Vtilde - rowMeans(Vtilde))^2) / (ncol(Vtilde) - 1)
    ordering <- order(rowSums(fit$V))
    C_gene_data[[length(C_gene_data) + 1]] <- cbind(key, data.frame(
      gene = rownames(fit$V)[ordering], rank = seq_len(nrow(fit$V)),
      observed_total = rowSums(fit$V)[ordering],
      inertia_Z = inertia[ordering], share_Z = 100 * inertia[ordering] / sum(inertia),
      variance_vtilde = variance[ordering], share_vtilde = 100 * variance[ordering] / sum(variance)))

    S <- s$r / sqrt(s$a) * sweep(fit$mu, 2, s$c / sqrt(s$b), "*")
    S0 <- project_nontrivial(S, u, v)
    N0 <- project_nontrivial(Z - S, u, v)
    total <- sum(E^2)
    signal_noise_split[[length(signal_noise_split) + 1]] <- cbind(key, data.frame(
      signal_pct = 100 * sum(S0^2) / total,
      noise_pct = 100 * sum(N0^2) / total,
      cross_pct = 200 * sum(S0 * N0) / total,
      decomposition_error = max(abs(E - S0 - N0)),
      left_trivial_pair_error = max(abs(Z %*% v - u)),
      right_trivial_pair_error = max(abs(crossprod(Z, u) - v)),
      ordinary_variance_error = max(abs(variance - apply(Vtilde, 1, var)))))

    if (seed == representative_draw) {
      genes <- gene_geometry(fit)
      samples <- sample_geometry(fit)
      D_genes[[length(D_genes) + 1]] <- cbind(key, genes$points)
      D_vertices[[length(D_vertices) + 1]] <- cbind(key, genes$vertices)
      S_samples[[length(S_samples) + 1]] <- cbind(key, samples$points)
      S_vertices[[length(S_vertices) + 1]] <- cbind(key, samples$vertices)
      projection_checks[[length(projection_checks) + 1]] <- cbind(
        key, side = "genes", genes$checks)
      names(samples$checks)[names(samples$checks) == "svd_coordinate_identity_error"] <- "coordinate_identity_error"
      projection_checks[[length(projection_checks) + 1]] <- cbind(
        key, side = "samples", samples$checks[names(genes$checks)])
    }
  }
  if (noise_model == "Poisson") {
    sim$observed <- sim$mu
    for (sc in scalings) {
      fit0 <- fit_view(sim, sc)
      noiseless_metrics[[length(noiseless_metrics) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        draw = seed, scaling = sc,
        oracle_W_rmse = fit0$metrics$oracle_W_rmse,
        oracle_H_rmse = fit0$metrics$oracle_H_rmse)
    }
  }
}
projection_metrics <- do.call(rbind, projection_metrics)
oracle_W <- do.call(rbind, oracle_W)
oracle_H <- do.call(rbind, oracle_H)
noiseless_metrics <- do.call(rbind, noiseless_metrics)
C_gene_data <- do.call(rbind, C_gene_data)
signal_noise_split <- do.call(rbind, signal_noise_split)
D_genes <- do.call(rbind, D_genes)
D_vertices <- do.call(rbind, D_vertices)
S_samples <- do.call(rbind, S_samples)
S_vertices <- do.call(rbind, S_vertices)
projection_checks <- do.call(rbind, projection_checks)
print(projection_metrics, row.names = FALSE)
```

## C: where variation sits after bi-marginal whitening

For gene g, `q_g = sum_i (Z_gi - sqrt(a_g * b_i))^2`; its share is
`100 * q_g / sum(q)`. This is weighted variation, or correspondence-analysis
inertia, including both signal and noise. In profile notation it is
`a_g * sum_i (p_gi - b_i)^2 / b_i`, where `p_gi = Vtilde_gi / a_g`.
The total equals the sum of squared nontrivial singular values.
When b is uniform, `q_g = (n - 1) * var(Z[g, ])`: this comparison to ordinary
variance concerns rows of Z. The Vtilde variance below is a different
quantity. The figure is not a plot of noise alone.

Each draw ranks its own genes by observed total. Lines show the arithmetic
mean at each rank; bands show the minimum and maximum across draws, not a
confidence interval. When zero-row filtering leaves different gene counts,
retain ranks through the smallest count, as in the original C generator.

```{r panel-c-data}
summarise_ranks <- function(value_column) {
  rows <- list()
  for (noise_model in models) for (sc in scalings) {
    d <- subset(C_gene_data, model == noise_model & scaling == sc)
    m <- min(table(d$draw))
    mat <- vapply(draw_seeds, function(seed) {
      z <- subset(d, draw == seed)
      z[[value_column]][order(z$rank)][seq_len(m)]
    }, numeric(m))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(model = noise_model, scaling = sc,
      rank = seq_len(m), mean = rowMeans(mat), lo = apply(mat, 1, min), hi = apply(mat, 1, max))
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
C_share_Z <- summarise_ranks("share_Z")
C_share_vtilde <- summarise_ranks("share_vtilde")

plot_rank_shares <- function(data, title, y_title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(rank, mean, colour = scaling, fill = scaling)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = band_alpha, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_y_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = scaling_colours) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scaling_colours) +
    facet_wrap(~model, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Gene rank by observed total (low to high)", y = y_title)
}
```

```{r panel-c-plot}
plot_C <- plot_rank_shares(C_share_Z, "After bi-marginal whitening",
                           "Gene share of variation in Z (%)")
plot_C
```

## Alternative C: ordinary variance before bi-marginal whitening

This alternative uses `var(Vtilde[g, ])`, the ordinary within-gene variance
across samples, and divides it by the sum of gene variances. It includes
signal and noise. Its denominator is neither inertia in Z nor variation
of all entries about one grand mean. This is the `panelC_vtilde` alternative.

```{r panel-c-vtilde-plot}
plot_C_vtilde <- plot_rank_shares(C_share_vtilde, "Before bi-marginal whitening",
                                 "Gene share of total variance in Vtilde (%)")
plot_C_vtilde
```

## Signal, perturbation and cross term diagnostic

This retains `panelC/signal_noise_split.R`. With fitted weights
`l = r/sqrt(a)`, `t = c/sqrt(b)`, let `S = D_l mu D_t`, `N = Z - S`,
`P = I - sqrt(a) sqrt(a)^T` and `Q = I - sqrt(b) sqrt(b)^T`.
Then `E = Z - sqrt(a) sqrt(b)^T = P S Q + P N Q` and
`||E||^2 = ||PSQ||^2 + ||PNQ||^2 + 2 <PSQ, PNQ>`.
The terms below divide by `||E||^2` and sum to 100%; the cross term can be
negative. The perturbation for floored normal noise includes the flooring
bias relative to the pre-floor `mu`.

```{r signal-noise-diagnostic}
split_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("signal_pct", "noise_pct", "cross_pct"), function(term) {
  data.frame(signal_noise_split[c("model", "draw", "scaling")],
             term, percent = signal_noise_split[[term]])
}))
plot_signal_noise <- ggplot(split_long, aes(term, percent, colour = scaling)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scaling_colours) + facet_wrap(~model) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Term / total nontrivial variation (%)")
plot_signal_noise
```

## D and sample companion: representative simplices

The representative gene plot reports W oracle RMSE; the sample companion
reports H oracle RMSE. They use the same representative signal/noise draws
and match individual points in E/F, rather than their across-draw means.

```{r panel-d-plots, fig.height=8}
representative_metrics <- subset(projection_metrics, draw == representative_draw)
plot_D <- plot_simplices(D_genes, D_vertices, representative_metrics, "W", ncol = length(models))
plot_D
plot_S <- plot_simplices(S_samples, S_vertices, representative_metrics, "H", ncol = length(models))
plot_S
```

## E and F: paired oracle errors

Dots are individual draws. Grey lines pair the two scalings of the same
observed matrix; short bars show arithmetic means. The W and H panels have
separate vertical scales because their units differ.

```{r panel-ef-plots}
oracle_means <- aggregate(cbind(oracle_W_rmse, oracle_H_rmse) ~ model + scaling,
                          projection_metrics, mean)
print(oracle_means, row.names = FALSE)
plot_oracle <- function(side) {
  d <- projection_metrics
  d$scaling <- factor(d$scaling, levels = scalings)
  d$error <- d[[paste0("oracle_", side, "_rmse")]]
  ggplot(d, aes(scaling, error)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = draw), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = scaling), size = 2) +
    stat_summary(aes(colour = scaling), fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = scaling_colours) + facet_wrap(~model, nrow = 1) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(title = paste(side, "oracle error"), x = NULL, y = "oracle RMSE")
}
plot_E <- plot_oracle("W")
plot_F <- plot_oracle("H")
plot_E / plot_F
```

## Diagnostics, provenance and saving experiments

These diagnostics print properties for inspection; they do not reject or
select a simulated draw. Uniform scaling convergence is in
`projection_metrics$uniform_converged`; individual oracle factor entries
are in `oracle_W` and `oracle_H`. `A_fits` retains A's observed matrix,
fitted weights and GSVD. `C_gene_data` retains every gene's unrounded
variation, share and rank for every draw/scaling/model.

```{r diagnostics}
print(A_checks, row.names = FALSE)
print(projection_checks, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Heatmap fraction range:", range(Hshow), "; column sums:", range(colSums(Hshow)), "\n")
cat("Genes removed from A:", nrow(A$observed) - nrow(A_fits$uniform$V), "\n")
cat("Maximum decomposition error:", max(signal_noise_split$decomposition_error), "\n")
cat("Maximum trivial-pair errors:", max(signal_noise_split$left_trivial_pair_error),
    max(signal_noise_split$right_trivial_pair_error), "\n")
cat("Maximum ordinary-variance discrepancy:", max(signal_noise_split$ordinary_variance_error), "\n")
cat("Range of summed decomposition terms (%):",
    range(rowSums(signal_noise_split[c("signal_pct", "noise_pct", "cross_pct")])), "\n")
cat("Maximum noiseless W/H RMSE:", max(noiseless_metrics$oracle_W_rmse),
    max(noiseless_metrics$oracle_H_rmse), "\n")
cat("All outputs are illustrative simulations.\n")
```

Optional exports go to a new experiment folder. Run this chunk yourself
after choosing a folder name; it is disabled during knitting.

```{r save-experiment, eval=FALSE}
experiment_dir <- "out/fig1_experiment_01"
dir.create(experiment_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(experiment_dir, "gene_simplices.png"), plot_D, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(experiment_dir, "sample_simplices.png"), plot_S, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(experiment_dir, "oracle_errors.png"), plot_E / plot_F, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
write.csv(projection_metrics, file.path(experiment_dir, "projection_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(list(mixture_parameters = mixture_parameters, library_fraction = library_fraction,
  panel_A_seed = panel_A_seed, draw_seeds = draw_seeds, noise_parameters = noise_parameters,
  A = A, mass_by_gene = mass_by_gene, mass_by_sample = mass_by_sample,
  C_gene_data = C_gene_data, signal_noise_split = signal_noise_split,
  projection_metrics = projection_metrics, oracle_W = oracle_W, oracle_H = oracle_H,
  D_genes = D_genes, D_vertices = D_vertices, S_samples = S_samples, S_vertices = S_vertices,
  noiseless_metrics = noiseless_metrics, session_info = sessionInfo()),
  file.path(experiment_dir, "experiment.rds"))
```
